title: Allevia: generous living in dense Mont'Kiara.
excerpt: Careful tower placement, expressive architecture and spacious three-bedroom homes make a strong own-stay case in a competitive address.
takeaways: Two towers with four units per floor and step-free access throughout.
A 1,971 sq ft unit with only three bedrooms, renting fully furnished for RM11,000.
Density, a planned road link and basic facilities are the concerns.

sections.heading: What sets it apart
paragraphs: Allevia has two square towers with just four units per floor, served by four lifts, and a level, step-free route from the drop-off to the front door. The 1,971 sq ft Type C1 has only three bedrooms plus a utility room, so the space goes to the shared rooms: a column-free living and dining area of about 7 by 8 metres under a 3-metre ceiling, a separate wet kitchen beside the pantry, and a large helper's room.
Units were changing hands at around RM1,000 psf, about RM1.9 million to RM2 million, and this one rents fully furnished for RM11,000 a month.

sections.heading: Where it is
paragraphs: It is on Jalan Mont Kiara 4, for now a dead end used only by residents of a few blocks, with a side gate to Jalan Mont Kiara 3. Mont Kiara International School, Garden International School and the 163 and Arcoris shops and offices are within walking distance.

pros: Mont Kiara itself: mature amenities, walkable without a car, and more international schools than anywhere else, which keeps expatriate demand and rents high. This unit fetches RM11,000; a one-bedroom at 163 about RM6,000.
The design: towers spaced apart and angled for views, speed ramps in the car park, fabric-textured concrete, step-free access and an inventive landscaped deck.
Sean's favourite layout: nearly 2,000 sq ft with only three bedrooms, so the living, dining, kitchen and in-between spaces are generous, with big windows throughout.
cons: Density and new supply, with more plots still to be built along Jalan Mont Kiara 3; the numbers still work, as an instalment of about RM8,000 to RM10,000 is covered by rent of RM10,000 to RM11,000.
A planned link from Jalan Mont Kiara 4 to Jalan Mont Kiara 3 would make trips such as the school run easier, but end the privacy of the dead end.
Basic facilities for about RM1,000 psf: one badminton court, a pool, a playground, an unfinished gym and an unremarkable rooftop, dressed up by good design.

closing: For walkable Mont Kiara living with generous space, Allevia delivers; just don't buy it for the facilities.
sourceNote: Based on Sean's full English captions for this October 2025 episode. The 3 on 3 follows the three things he likes and the three concerns he names, in his order, at the end of the video. An owner let Sean view the unit; prices and rents are as he quoted them.
